status: PRE-DATA for pv10-strict-v2 cells; POST-DATA for the voided PV10-A v1 cells
title: Stop-sequence semantics unified across alpha=0 and +-4; marker excluded before parsing

what_failed.observed: 58 of 60 PV10-A v1 episodes terminated as invalid_policy; 0/20 alpha=0 episodes reached the fixed budget n=100, so the fixed-budget control never exercised its own design.

root_causes.defect: llms.VicundaModel.generate() had no stop_strings parameter while regenerate() did. alpha=0 registers no hook and therefore takes the generate path, so alpha=0 cells generated with NO stop marker while their own +-4 cells stopped on '#'.
root_causes.consequence: The two arms of one experiment had different generation boundaries. Any alpha contrast was confounded by generation length, not only by steering.
root_causes.evidence: median generation chars, PV10-A: a0(generate)=489 vs ap4(regenerate)=226; stop-marker hit rate 0.690 vs 0.776. PV10-B: a0=413 vs ap4=157.
root_causes.fix: generate() gained stop_strings (default None, so every pre-existing caller is byte-identical) and forwards the tokenizer as HF requires; the episode runner now passes p10.STOP_STRINGS on BOTH paths.

root_causes.defect: HF stop_strings halts only AFTER the marker is emitted, leaving it in the returned text, while _POLICY_RE anchors on $ and tolerates only [.!]. The runtime treated '#' as a boundary and the parser did not.
root_causes.consequence: A canonical Policy line ending in the marker was read as malformed; 47 of 58 terminating rounds died this way.
root_causes.fix: bandit_pv10.apply_stop_boundary() truncates at the first marker, EXCLUDING it. The episode parses only the truncated text.

explicitly_rejected_alternatives.why_rejected: Rescues only the 33 bare-marker cases, not the 14 inline-comment cases; tolerating the comment too would be equivalent to truncation but with a permanently looser regex.

explicitly_rejected_alternatives.option: (b) give PV10-A its own stop string
explicitly_rejected_alternatives.why_rejected: Breaks the A/B shared-object guarantee that makes the two protocols comparable.

explicitly_rejected_alternatives.option: delete the 'must name exactly one button' clause from PV10-A
explicitly_rejected_alternatives.why_rejected: FALSIFIED. PV10-B contains the identical clause (bandit_pv10.py) and does not fail, and the 33-case majority has no echoed text to delete. Diagnosis corrected before any edit was made.

strictness_preserved.claim: This is a control-token boundary fix, NOT parser leniency.
still_invalid: prose after the arm (explained instead of committing)
two or more conflicting directives before the marker
no canonical directive before the marker
arm outside the episode arm set

version_changes.resume_safety: v1 cells cannot resume into v2 cells; new results must be written to a new directory.

data_status.pv10a_v1_a0_am4_ap4: VOID -- interface failure. Not analysable for accuracy, RSN or alpha effects.
data_status.pv10b_v1_comparability_caveat: PV10-B v1 ran with the alpha=0/+-4 stop asymmetry (RC1) and the v1 parser (RC2). An offline v2 re-parse changes 1 round in 412 (a0), 1 in 307 (am4), 0 in 343 (ap4) -- so most ACTIONS are unchanged. This does NOT restore the affected round: a changed action alters every subsequent state, and re-parsing cannot regenerate the trajectory. A strict A/B comparison therefore requires PV10-B to be re-run under v2; the stored v1 results remain valid on their own terms.

test_coverage.negative_control: 6 of its checks verified to FAIL against pre-fix code at commit HEAD
test_coverage.limitation: Unit tests verify the harness contract only. They cannot show a real model will stay in format under the fixed-budget prompt -- only a GPU run can.

rerun_order: confirm episodes reach n=100 and no new systematic malformed mode
only then +-4; no blind three-cell parallel run
